title: 伊泽瑞尔·旅行小收藏
description: 金发伊泽瑞尔戴圆护目镜，穿完整探险装，把小石头和贝壳排成一列，魔法护手静置。

art_direction.medium: thick wax crayon on warm paper
art_direction.identity: Ezreal is a blond young adult explorer with blue eyes, tousled hair, round goggles on his head, and recognizable blue markings on his cheeks. Keep his brown-and-blue travel jacket, fully covering shirt, opaque trousers, gloves, and boots. His ornate golden magical gauntlet remains attached to one forearm but unlit and inactive, preserving the explorer identity without an energy blast.
art_direction.scene: He sits cross-legged beside an open travel bag, arranging a few smooth stones and shells on a folded cloth as little souvenirs. One boot toe points toward a particularly interesting round pebble. A simple archway and a small potted plant form the background, and no map writing or ancient inscriptions appear anywhere.
art_direction.palette: sunny blond, sky blue, leather brown, soft gold
art_direction.weapon_policy: iconic static prop, no attacks or firing

visual_qa.method: up to ten images on a compressed JPEG contact sheet, max edge 1280
